<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm): 135.43 (2), 130.70 (2), 130.40 (2), 128.70 (2), 128.35 (2), 124.85 (2). Each appears twice, indicating two equivalent carbons per shift. Summing these gives 7 × 2 = 14 aromatic carbon atoms. The remaining peaks are aliphatic, so they are not counted.</thought>
<final_answer>14</final_answer>
